datasheet_identity.title: BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: BZX84C16 is the 16 V nominal zener variant in the BZX84C2V4 THRU BZX84C75 series.
The electrical-characteristics row gives VZ minimum 15.3 V, nominal 16 V, and maximum 17.1 V at IZT = 5 mA; the retained breakdown voltage is the nominal typical value.
The row gives maximum zener impedance ZZT = 200 ohm at IZT = 5 mA and ZZK = 200 ohm at IZK = 1 mA; these fields are not represented by the extraction schema.
The p. 3 zener-characteristics plot is a family graph; the curve points are manual readings of the curve labelled 16 and are not interpolated.
No tabulated capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published for BZX84C16. The capacitance family plot is not uniquely attributable to the 16 V variant, so capacitance is null.
Power dissipation is 300 mW maximum and admissible zener current IZM is 5 mA for BZX84C16, both at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.
omission_reason: No reverse-recovery data is published. No uniquely attributable BZX84C16 capacitance value is published; the family capacitance plot does not identify individual variant curves sufficiently for a schema value.
